THE QUESTION

When participation dries up after a strong move, what happens next?

We translate that observation into measurable rules and test whether the same sequence repeats often enough to matter.

2,903NSE stocks analysed
325complete behaviour sequences
65.2%re-expansion in one historical behaviour group
WHY SRIDAH

One chart can suggest an idea. It cannot prove one.

Markets generate endless signals, patterns and opinions. SriDah is being built to separate interesting observations from repeatable evidence.

CURRENT QUESTIONS

The platform grows by answering better questions about market behaviour.

MARKET RESILIENCE

When the market weakens, which stocks refuse to weaken with it?

Relative resilience during index stress may reveal demand that is not obvious from the stock chart alone.

VOLUME DRY-UP

After a strong move, does disappearing participation improve the next setup?

We test whether declining volume during consolidation changes continuation probability, speed or drawdown.

ABNORMAL PRICE VELOCITY

When price suddenly accelerates, is that continuation or buyer exhaustion?

Quantify abnormal acceleration and test what separates continued demand dominance from short-term exhaustion.

HOW WE BUILD

Quant research at the core. ML, AI, LLMs and agents around it.

SriDah is being built from the research outward. Technology is used where it improves discovery, context, monitoring or execution.

ObserveIdentify a behaviour worth understanding.
DefineTranslate it into measurable variables.
TestRun the hypothesis across historical cohorts.
ValidateCheck whether the result survives another period.
MonitorFind the behaviour in the live market.
LearnFeed outcomes back into future research.

Quantitative Research

Cohort design, forward outcomes, MFE/MAE, statistical testing and validation.

Machine Learning

Interactions, ranking, regime sensitivity and relationships that fixed rules may miss.

AI & LLMs

Corporate announcements, earnings commentary, context, reasoning and explanation.

Agents

Continuous observation, monitoring, evaluation and eventually execution within defined rules.
